application.task_transport: UDP application messages through six logical stages
application.success_definition: actuator receives matching task_id, payload within tolerance, before deadline

latency.definition: application end-to-end latency for delivered tasks; interval mean

packet_loss.definition: 1 - on-time delivered task count / expected task count

utilization.definition: measured interface bytes per second divided by configured link bytes per second, clipped to [0,1]

availability.definition: successful application heartbeat/task receipts divided by expected receipts

sensor_quality.definition: fraction of delivered sensor payloads within absolute tolerance of evaluator ground truth

detector_score.definition: benign-calibrated anomaly score using observable latency, packet_loss, utilization, availability only

mission_outcome.mission_effectiveness: successful tasks / expected tasks over rolling 10-interval window

model_transfer.reason: avoid post-hoc selection of a single horizon
